Name: Noise
Description: The perceptual scale of the Voronoi shapes. Higher values create more, smaller shapes; lower values produce fewer, larger cells.

Name: Scale
Description: The perceptual scale of the Voronoi shapes. Higher values create more, smaller shapes; lower values produce fewer, larger cells.

Name: Jitter
Description: Controls the offset of the Voronoi points, ranging from perfectly symmetrical (low jitter) to highly chaotic (high jitter) cell placement.

Name: Function
Description: Specifies the distance function used to calculate Voronoi cells, affecting the shape and boundaries of each cell.

Flubs.Name: Euclidean
Flubs.Description: Uses the standard Euclidean distance, resulting in natural, rounded cell shapes.

Flubs.Name: Manhattan
Flubs.Description: Uses the Manhattan (grid-based) distance, producing square or diamond-shaped cells.

Name: Form
Description: Determines how the height or value of each Voronoi cell is calculated, affecting the resulting terrain or pattern.

Flubs.Name: C
Flubs.Description: Voronoi cells with height determined by the cell itself, creating classic cell-based patterns.

Flubs.Name: N
Flubs.Description: Voronoi cells with height determined by the nearest neighbor, resulting in smoother transitions between cells.

Flubs.Name: R
Flubs.Description: Voronoi cells with height influenced by the distance to the cell's edge, creating ring-like or ridge effects.

Flubs.Name: P
Flubs.Description: The default look for this geo-variant, suitable for creating mountainous terrain with prominent peaks.

Flubs.Name: A
Flubs.Description: A mix between the P and M forms, blending characteristics of both for varied terrain features.

Flubs.Name: S
Flubs.Description: Generates individual mountains with fully separated boundaries, emphasizing isolated peaks.

Flubs.Name: M
Flubs.Description: Favors the strongest cell, ideal for creating a large mountain slope or dominant landform.

Flubs.Name: D
Flubs.Description: Emphasizes ridges over cell centers, producing terrain with pronounced ridge lines.

Name: Gain
Description: Adjusts the contrast or intensity of the Voronoi pattern, amplifying or reducing the difference between cell heights.

Name: Clamp
Description: Limits the output values to a specified range, preventing extreme heights or depths in the generated pattern.

Name: Seed
Description: The randomization pattern or seed for the node's process. Changing the seed produces different Voronoi arrangements.

Name: Warp
Description: Specifies the type of warp applied to the Voronoi pattern, controlling the complexity of the distortion.

Name: Type
Description: Specifies the type of warp applied to the Voronoi pattern, controlling the complexity of the distortion.

Flubs.Name: None
Flubs.Description: No warping is applied; the Voronoi pattern remains unaltered.

Flubs.Name: Simple
Flubs.Description: Applies basic warping to the pattern, introducing gentle distortions.

Flubs.Name: Complex
Flubs.Description: Applies advanced, multi-layered warping for highly intricate and organic distortions.

Name: Frequency
Description: Controls the frequency of the warp, determining how often the pattern is distorted across the terrain.

Name: Amplitude
Description: Sets the strength of the warp effect, controlling how far the Voronoi cells are displaced.

Name: Octaves
Description: Specifies the number of detail layers used in the warp, increasing the complexity and richness of the distortion.

Name: Transform
Description: The non-uniform scale of the X axis, stretching or compressing the pattern horizontally.

Name: Scale X
Description: The non-uniform scale of the X axis, stretching or compressing the pattern horizontally.

Name: Scale Y
Description: The non-uniform scale of the Y axis, stretching or compressing the pattern vertically.

Name: X
Description: Offsets the Voronoi pattern along the X axis, shifting its position horizontally.

Name: Y
Description: Offsets the Voronoi pattern along the Y axis, shifting its position vertically.
